en.title: Boundary of the Low Tide Line
en.premise: At 04:12, a body is discovered in a reef zone during low tide. The victim, a researcher of underwater ruins, was found clutching an ancient nautical chart believed to have been purchased from a secondhand bookstore. As an investigator uncovers a connection between the tidal cycles and the inexplicable circumstances of the murder, political pressures within the organization collide with the silent memories slumbering beneath the sea.

zh.title: 低潮线的边界
zh.premise: 凌晨04时12分，在退潮时的礁石地带发现了一具尸体。被害者是一名海底遗迹研究员，手中紧握着一张疑似从旧书店购得的古老航海图。随着调查员察觉到潮汐周期与离奇杀人现场之间的诡异关联，组织内部的政治压力与沉睡在深海之下的沉默记忆，开始交织碰撞。
